posts.description: It's been almost a month since we moved to Quincy, MA. Our moving date was May 22nd, 2026, I am only now coming back to the blog. posts.title: Day 3 in Brazil (Rio de Janeiro)
posts.description: After taking a couple of days off from the gym, I went to the Pestana gym to lift. The view from the gym was beautiful, with a line of sight over the beach and the cerulean ocean. I sunbathed on the rooftop by the pool after setting my out of office automatic reply in Outlook. I jumped in and out of the water to cool off in the heat of the mid-morning sun.
